title: LUKO game event (v3)
description: One event a game sends to the LUKO site. Explained in Persian in docs/event-tracking-guide.md. The site adds user_id and game_id itself; a game must never send them.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event (UUID v4). Lets the server ignore a re-send.

session_id.description: One play of one game, from opening it to leaving. Same for every event of that play.

event_type.description: What happened. The core types are listed; a game may add its own in the same snake_case form.

concept_tag.description: Educational tag code defined by the design team (dashboard → تگ‌های آموزشی). Required on answer, hint and mistake; empty string otherwise.

timestamp.description: When it happened on the child's device: milliseconds since 1970-01-01 UTC.

level.description: Level number inside the game (1, 2, …), or null before the first level.

data.description: Details. Standard keys are below; anything else is kept as raw data (numbers and short codes only — never names or free text).

time_taken_ms.description: answer: thinking time in ms, from question shown (or previous attempt) to this answer

attempt_number.description: answer: 1 for the first try at this question, 2 for the second, …

error_type.description: wrong answer or mistake: why it was wrong, as decided by the design team for each wrong option

hint_used.description: answer: a hint was shown before this answer

question_id.description: answer: the game's own id for the question

status.description: added by the SDK: game state at the moment

level_id.description: added by the SDK: id of the running level

score.description: added by the SDK: score at the moment
